user.title: Set up HealthLink
user.description: No YAML, webhook URL, token or sensor IDs are required. HealthLink automatically discovers Apple Health sensors from the official Home Assistant iPhone app. Detected iPhones: {device_count}.

general.title: General settings
general.description: The defaults are recommended. HealthLink uses your official Home Assistant iPhone app automatically; most users only need to choose how much history to use for personal baselines.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: HealthLink stays local. Sensitive health metrics are not exposed as normal Home Assistant entities unless you explicitly allow them.
